review_candidates.description: DevOps & Cloud Security Engineer Experience: 3–5 years | Location: Gurugram | Type: Full-time Role Own our entire Azure and Microsoft stack end-to-end — infrastructure, containers, data platform, security and monitoring. You will design the architecture, keep it documented and current, and make sure nothing breaks silently. Azure Infrastructure — Manage VMs, VNets, NSGs, App Gateway, Front Door, Entra ID/RBAC and cost optimisation. Infrastructure as Code via Terraform/Bicep. Containers — Run and upgrade AKS / Container Apps and ACR; build hardened, minimal Docker images with CVE scanning in the pipeline. Databases — Administer relational databases (Azure SQL / SQL Server, PostgreSQL / MySQL) : schema and index management, query performance tuning, high availability, replication, automated backups and tested point-in-time restores. Also manage MongoDB (replica sets, sharding, backups, restore testing). Search & Log Store — Manage Elasticsearch / OpenSearch clusters: index lifecycle and retention policies, shard and node sizing, snapshots, query performance, cluster health monitoring and secure access. Maintain the ELK/EFK stack used for centralised logging where applicable. Data Platform — Own Microsoft Fabric and OneLake : workspace setup, capacity management, access control, pipelines and data governance. Business Application Integrations — Manage Dynamics 365 and ERP environments and their APIs — authentication, integration pipelines, data sync, error handling, rate limits, monitoring and environment refreshes. Secrets Management — Own Azure Key Vault. Enforce a scheduled secret, key and certificate rotation policy ; zero hardcoded credentials anywhere. 24×7 Monitoring & Alerting — Set up full-stack observability (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights, Grafana). Define SLIs/SLOs and configure alerts so that any anomaly triggers a notification immediately , routed to the right on-call channel with minimal noise. Log Retention & Governance — Define and maintain retention policies per log type (application, security, audit, infra) with correct archival tiers and compliance alignment. Security & Vulnerability Management — Continuous scanning across servers, containers and dependencies; triage and remediate CVEs within SLA. Operate Defender for Cloud / Sentinel. Patch Management — Keep all servers and container images current — OS, kernel, runtimes and libraries — on a documented cadence, with emergency patching for critical CVEs. Automation & Cron Inventory — Maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) and a documented register of every cron and scheduled job: what it does, why it exists, schedule, owner and failure alerting. Backup & DR — Own backup strategy across all workloads with regular tested restores and a drilled DR plan (defined RTO/RPO). Documentation — Keep runbooks, SOPs, change logs and asset inventory accurate and current. Undocumented infrastructure is treated as incomplete work. You must be able to review, test and take full ownership of anything AI-generated before it touches our infrastructure. Good to Have Basic working knowledge of AWS (EC2, S3, IAM) and GCP · Microsoft Sentinel / SIEM · Cloudflare · Power Platform / Dataverse · Azure Data Factory or Synapse · ISO 27001 / SOC 2 exposure Certifications (Preferred) AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-500, CKA/CKS What We Look For Ownership mindset, disciplined documentation habits, security-first thinking, and calm handling of production incidents. Willingness to be on-call.

review_candidates.title: Senior Networking Consultant
review_candidates.company: Collins McNicholas Recruitment & HR Services Group
review_candidates.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Networking Consultant to join an established Enterprise Infrastructure team. This is a hands-on technical role focused on the design, implementation, support and optimisation of secure and resilient enterprise network environments. The successful candidate will work across multi-vendor networking, managed services, connectivity and security environments, taking ownership of technical activities, resolving complex network issues and supporting customers across a varied infrastructure environment. The role would suit an experienced network professional with a background in enterprise, ISP, MSP, managed services or telecommunications environments, who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working directly with customers and taking ownership of solutions from initial investigation through implementation and operational support. The position is based onsite County Roscommon. Key Responsibilities Design, configure, implement and support enterprise network solutions. Configure and deploy network switching, routing, connectivity and security technologies. Support wired and wireless network infrastructure and WAN connectivity. Lead and support network installations, upgrades, migrations and controlled technical changes. Diagnose and resolve complex routing, switching, connectivity, VPN and network performance issues. Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex customer and infrastructure issues. Provide managed services support across customer network and IT infrastructure environments. Monitor network infrastructure, identify potential issues and take proactive action to maintain service availability. Support network security, segmentation, access control and secure connectivity. Work with customers, vendors and internal technical teams to investigate and resolve infrastructure issues. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers and support colleagues. Maintain accurate technical documentation, service records and operational procedures. Take ownership of technical activities through to resolution, implementation and operational handover. Contribute to continuous improvement of network services, support processes and technical standards. Technical Experience The successful candidate should have experience across a strong selection of the following: Multi-vendor enterprise networking environments. Cisco, Meraki, Fortinet or comparable networking and security technologies. ISP, MSP, managed services or telecommunications environments. Enterprise LAN, WAN and internet connectivity. Routing and switching technologies. TCP/IP networking and associated network services. DNS, DHCP, NAT and VPN technologies. Network security, firewall and secure connectivity technologies. Network troubleshooting, monitoring and fault diagnosis. Customer network infrastructure and remote technical support. Vendor-agnostic troubleshooting across different networking hardware and operating systems. Experience with additional enterprise networking, security, wireless, SD-WAN or secure-access technologies would be advantageous. Experience & Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: A minimum of 5 years' experience in network engineering, managed services, telecommunications or a comparable technical role. Strong practical experience supporting and troubleshooting network infrastructure. Experience working with multiple networking and security vendors. Experience in an ISP, MSP, managed services, enterprise IT or telecommunications environment. Proven ability to investigate and resolve complex technical escalations. Experience delivering network implementations, upgrades, migrations or infrastructure changes. Strong customer-facing and stakeholder communication skills. Experience working within structured service delivery, incident and change-management environments. Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring or support to other engineers would be advantageous. Relevant networking or security certifications, such as Cisco, Fortinet or equivalent, would be advantageous. A relevant degree or qualification in networking, telecommunications, computer systems or a related discipline would be advantageous. What Is Offered Highly competitive salary. Company pension scheme. Bonus scheme. 22 days' annual leave. Enhanced sick pay scheme. Funded technical training and professional development. Support towards achieving relevant industry and vendor accreditations. Collaborative and professional working environment. Opportunities to work with a broad range of enterprise networking, security and infrastructure technologies. For further details on this position please call Gillian Nicholson at gillian.nicholson@colllins mcnicholas.ie
